metadata.name: Marine sediment porewater chemistry from Azores deep-sea core M186_54-1GC
metadata.description: Dataset containing 19 porewater samples from a single deep-sea sediment core (Station M186_54-1GC) collected during cruise event M186_54-1 in the Azores region. The core spans approximately 0.28 to 3.81 meters sediment depth at a subsea elevation of -1234 m. Measurements include major ions (Cl⁻, Na⁺, SO₄²⁻, Mg²⁺, Br⁻, Ca²⁺, Sr²⁺, K⁺, Li⁺, B, Si) in millimolar (mM), nutrients ([NO₃]⁻, [NO₂]⁻, [NH₄]⁺, [PO₄]³⁻) and trace elements (Mn, Fe, Ba) in micromolar (µM), and alkalinity (AT) in mM. All samples were collected at a single location and timestamp (2022-12-16 07:56:17 UTC), representing a vertical profile for diagenetic and redox zonation analysis.
metadata.spatial: point location at 38.74553°N, 28.56587°W; vertical resolution defined by 19 discrete sediment depth intervals from 0.28 m to 3.81 m
metadata.temporal: single point in time (2022-12-16 07:56:17 UTC); second-level precision
